notifications.message: You will be notified again at 40%, 60%, 80%, 90%, 95% and 97%. Use these as a reference for pacing your work. As a rule of thumb, start preparing a handoff when the 90% notice arrives.
It is fine to keep working. Once usage passes 90%, start thinking about a handoff.

This is not fatal yet, so stay calm. Report it to the user; if work is in progress, it is fine to bring it to a natural stopping point. Do not start any large new task; hand off to the next session instead. The next notice comes at 95%.
If you are in the middle of something, let go of it soon and start preparing the handoff.
Ask the user to run a /compact right now!
